llm.guidance: This skill looks like a thin wrapper that will call the 'gws' CLI to send Gmail replies, which is reasonable — but it defers authentication and global flags to a '../gws-shared/SKILL.md' file that is not included in the package. Before installing or enabling this skill: 1) Inspect the referenced ../gws-shared/SKILL.md (or run 'gws generate-skills' as suggested) to see what credentials, OAuth scopes, config files, or environment variables it requires and where tokens are stored. 2) Verify the origin and integrity of the 'gws' binary (who built it, how it is installed) because the skill will execute that CLI. 3) Confirm the OAuth scopes requested are limited to sending/reading mail and not broader than necessary. 4) Use the '--dry-run' flag (mentioned in the SKILL.md) to preview actions before executing, and be cautious with attachments and reply-all operations. If you cannot locate or review the gws-shared SKILL.md and any auth config it references, avoid installing or enabling this skill because its credential requirements and behavior are unknown.
